items.headline: Baycurrent Classic Field
items.text: The PGA Tour's Baycurrent Classic in Yokohama, Japan features defending leader Xander Schauffele and a loaded FedEx Cup Fall field including Wyndham Clark, Hideki Matsuyama, and Collin Morikawa, airing Wednesday to Saturday from 11 p.m.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy Career Update
items.text: Rory McIlroy is second in the Race to Dubai standings behind Patrick Reed as he approaches the final stretch of his significant season.
